expect.name: Index-Galena Road (FR 63) from Index, or Beckler Road (FR 65) via Jack Pass as the current detour
expect.status: Direct Index-Galena Road access is closed to vehicles (~MP 10–14 washed out since Dec 2025); current access is via the Beckler Road/Jack Pass detour.
expect.driveNote: From US-2 near Index, FR 63 runs north along the North Fork Skykomish River, but its final miles to the trailhead are currently impassable to vehicles. The working detour is US-2 to Beckler Road (FR 65) near Skykomish, ~12.5 mi to Jack Pass, then ~1.8–2.5 mi on FR 63 to the Blanca Lake Trailhead — gravel, rough in spots, roughly 45 minutes longer than the old Index route; low-clearance cars and RVs can struggle.
expect.seasonalGate: The Beckler Road/Jack Pass detour closes seasonally with snow and is typically not reliably open until early summer.

value.name: Index-Galena Road (FR 63) from Index, or Beckler Road (FR 65) via Jack Pass (detour, currently closed)
value.status: Index-Galena Road (FR 63) has been closed to vehicles between mileposts 10 and 14 since December 2025 flood damage, with no repair timeline. The Beckler Road/Jack Pass detour is closed too: since June 30, 2026 the Forest Service lists FR 65 as graded only to Jack Pass (milepost 12.3) and closed beyond it for downed trees and a bridge out, and FR 63 as undrivable from the FR 65 side because the North Fork Skykomish bridge is out, so no vehicle route currently reaches the Blanca Lake Trailhead. Check with Snohomish County Public Works and the Skykomish Ranger District, (360) 677-2414, before you go.

expect.name: North Fork Skokomish / Staircase Road
expect.status: Pavement ends ~1.7 mi onto FR-24 from Hoodsport, then ~3.7 mi of gravel to the Staircase Ranger Station/trailhead. As of mid-2026, the developed Staircase area reopened July 8, 2026 after a year-long closure from the 2025 Bear Gulch Fire, but surrounding wilderness trails - including the Flapjack Lakes/North Fork Skokomish Trail used for this route's approach - remain closed for post-fire repair; verify current status before attempting.
expect.driveNote: Access is via the Staircase area of Olympic National Park (North Fork Skokomish). The Staircase developed area (road, campground, ranger station) was closed by the 2025 Bear Gulch Fire and is scheduled to reopen 7/8/2026, but the Flapjack Lakes and North Fork Skokomish trails beyond the developed area remain closed for hazard mitigation as of mid-2026 — confirm current road AND trail status before the trip.
expect.seasonalGate: Typically snow-affected/closed November-May in normal (non-fire-closure) years.
